_comment: Third-party indicator registries that publish per-persona dossiers. Same schema as x-dossiers.json and loaded by the same code (scripts/lib/dossiers.js), kept separate because the provenance differs: an X post is one researcher's public claim, a registry is a standing database. See docs/third-party-registries.md.
